title: Unit 10: Chemistry of Metals — Syllabus Overview
notes: Unit 10: Chemistry of Metals · Inorganic Chemistry · 5 teaching hours

• Metallurgical principles: metallurgy types, ores, gangue, flux, slag, alloy, amalgam
  • General extraction principles: concentration, calcination, roasting, smelting, carbon reduction, thermite, electrochemical reduction
  • Metal refining: poling and electro-refinement
  • Alkali Metals: Sodium extraction via Down's process, NaOH properties/uses, Na2CO3 properties/uses
  • Alkaline Earth Metals: Quick lime, bleaching powder, magnesia, plaster of Paris, Epsom salt formulas and uses; solubility trends of hydroxides/carbonates/sulphates; stability trends of carbonates/nitrates
